rule: Per task-model pair: a win when the pair's on arm is correct at least as often as its off arm and its median tokens.total or median turns is at least minCut below the off arm's. keep when the on arm is correct at least as often over all pairs and wins at least keepWinFraction of the pairs; retire when it wins none; freeze otherwise. Each pair also reports how many of its on cells called a codegraph tool, and the same rule over each task, both models pooled, prints beside as the pooled verdict.
